scope: Substantive refresh of an existing post at its URL, adding sources

observations.summary: Average household leaks can waste more than 9,300 gallons a year; 9 percent of homes have leaks wasting 50 gallons or more per day; family of four over 12,000 gallons a month in winter suggests serious leaks; two-hour meter test; toilet food coloring test after 10 minutes; replace flappers at least every five years.

The key to mold control is moisture control; wet materials dried within 24 to 48 hours after a leak usually will not grow mold; fix plumbing leaks as soon as possible; a moldy smell without a visible source can indicate hidden mold.

Replaced an uncited 'national studies' 180 gallons per week claim with the EPA figure; removed unsourced foundation erosion and 'advanced equipment' claims and a templated FAQ; added meter and dye tests, well-home note, FAQ and sources. Original date kept, updated added.
